New York City Department of Environmental Protection
Bureau of Water Supply - Natural Resources Division
CARPENTERS EDDY EAST
Forest Management Project # 5116
NOTICE OF PROJECT AVAILABILITY
Description: The City of New York will sell an estimated 187 MBF of hardwood sawtimber and 89 cords of hardwood pulp through Carpenters Eddy East Forest Management Project #5116 in the Cannonsville watershed basin.
Summary: This sale is comprised of mostly mature red oak and white ash. The project includes approximately 2.5 miles of trail construction and 27 acres of shelterwood regeneration.
Project Area: 103 ac +/-
Total Volume: 187 MBF +/- sawtimber & 89 cords hardwood pulp
Species as a percent of total sawtimber volume: 49% Red Oak, 22% White Ash, 14% Red Maple, 9% Chestnut Oak.
Show Dates: Prospective bidders should attend one of the public showings to receive the full bid package.
Bid Deadline: Sealed bids must be received by the date stated in the official notice.
